用力不均

略带蜡质的颜料质感

Can MiniMax H3 Make a Chinese-Style Vertical Drama? 🎬

I started watching these Asian short dramas made for phones ( vertical format, like TikTok) and got curious. Could I make one myself using MiniMax H3 in ComfyUI?

Well, here's Episode 1 of The Wrong Table!

My setup:
MiniMax H3 — 8 steps with Turbo LoRA
RTX 5090 — 24GB VRAM
64GB RAM
Restaurant background ambience added using ElevenLabs
9:16 vertical format

The whole episode took a little under 2 hours to put together. Each 12-second generation took approximately 23–24 minutes.

I also wanted to recreate that dramatic freeze-frame, white-flash ending you see in so many Asian short dramas. You know, where the camera flashes back and forth between two characters before freezing on someone's shocked expression!

I experimented with H3 and got an interesting result.

I've included the prompt below if anyone wants to try the effect themselves. Just use two reference images of the characters you want to flash back and forth between, and adjust the prompt to fit your scene.

Still experimenting, but it's been a fun little project!

Prompt for flash at end.

THE WRONG TABLE — EPISODE 1 — CLIFFHANGER FREEZE-FRAME ENDING

CRITICAL: NO ON-SCREEN TEXT OR SUBTITLES. No captions, names, titles, logos, or watermarks.

REFERENCE IMAGES:

<image 1> — CHEN YICHEN: Use the provided restaurant image of the male lead as the ONLY visual reference for the male character. Strictly preserve his original facial appearance, hairstyle, navy-blue suit jacket, light-blue shirt, calm expression with a slight smile, and the original restaurant background, lighting, and camera angle. Do not redesign the character.

<image 2> — SHEN RUOXI: Use the provided shocked close-up image of the female lead as the ONLY visual reference for the female character. Strictly preserve her original facial appearance, long hair, gold hoop earrings, dark-blue silk blouse, widened eyes, slightly parted lips, and the original background, lighting, and camera angle. Do not redesign the character.

integrated_multimodal_description: 9:16 vertical format, modern Chinese urban romantic short drama, cinematic photorealistic live-action visuals, classic Chinese short-drama suspenseful freeze-frame ending. The entire sequence uses ONLY the two original character images from <image 1> and <image 2>. Do not create new camera shots or change the characters' faces, expressions, clothing, compositions, or backgrounds. Create suspense through frozen images, rapid cuts, white flashes, soft misty light blooms, and fade-out effects. The character appearance order must strictly be: Shen Ruoxi → Chen Yichen → Shen Ruoxi.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, immediately show the shocked facial close-up of Shen Ruoxi from <image 2>. Her eyes are widened and her lips are slightly parted, preserving the exact shocked expression from the original image. The image freezes completely. No blinking, no head movement, and no lip movement. A soft, misty white glow gradually appears around the edges of the frame, followed by a rapid white flash at 00:00.850.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, immediately after the white flash, hard cut to the original restaurant image of Chen Yichen from <image 1>. Preserve his original seated posture, subtle smile, clothing, and background. The image remains completely frozen, creating a strong contrast with the female lead's shocked expression. Hold briefly, then introduce another rapid white flash.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.000, immediately after the flash, cut back to the original shocked close-up of Shen Ruoxi from <image 2>. The image instantly freezes, preserving her exact original facial expression and composition. Add a subtle, soft white misty glow around the edges, a hazy light bloom, and a brief ghosted afterimage overlay to create the suspenseful atmosphere of a classic Chinese short-drama cliffhanger ending. Her face must remain clearly visible at all times and must not be obscured by the white glow.

[Shot 4] At 00:03.000, continue holding the completely frozen close-up of Shen Ruoxi. The soft white glow briefly intensifies, then gradually diminishes. During the final half-second, smoothly fade the image to pure black. End at 00:04.000.

VISUAL CONTINUITY: Strictly preserve the characters' identities, original facial structures, hairstyles, clothing, natural skin textures, lighting, backgrounds, and camera compositions from the two reference images. All character images must remain completely motionless freeze-frames. Only editing transitions and subtle optical effects are permitted. Do not generate new actions, change facial expressions, animate lips, introduce additional characters, change locations, rotate the camera, zoom in, or zoom out. No subtitles, no text, no graphic titles, and no watermarks.

overall_soundscape: Begin with a short, deep cinematic suspense impact sound. Each rapid white flash is accompanied by a subtle, clean air-whoosh sound. During the final freeze-frame, maintain a brief lingering low-frequency suspense resonance that quickly disappears as the image fades out, ending in complete silence. No character dialogue, no voiceover, and no restaurant conversations.

non_diegetic_music: None. Use only brief suspense impact sound effects and white-flash transition sounds. No continuous background music.

使用提供的仓库参考图，创作一张地下工业科…

INDUSTRIAL WAREHOUSE RAVE — PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM

Using the supplied warehouse reference image, create an authentic documentary photograph of an underground industrial techno rave during a live DJ performance.

ARCHITECTURE AND COMPOSITION

Preserve the exact three-level warehouse architecture, structural columns, steel balconies, railings, central atrium, stage position, and elevated camera perspective. Maintain the recognizable geometry of the original building.

LIGHTING AND DARKNESS

Transform the venue into a genuinely dark underground nightclub. The ceiling and upper roof structure disappear almost entirely into deep black shadows. Glass roof panels and windows must not be visibly illuminated. Only faint, irregular silhouettes of concrete beams and structural elements emerge where occasional reflected light reaches them.

Preserve restrained violet and indigo architectural uplighting along the structural columns, with realistic light falloff and substantial darkness between fixtures.

The audience in the central dance floor becomes progressively darker away from direct light sources. Most people appear as overlapping silhouettes, with occasional rim lighting outlining heads, shoulders, hair, and raised arms. Avoid uniformly illuminating the backs of the audience.

People along the left and right ground-floor edges remain partially visible under localized overhead lighting, with natural variation in exposure. Balcony spectators receive intermittent reflected stage lighting, leaving many faces and bodies partially obscured.

STAGE AND PERFORMANCE

Maintain the DJ booth and performance stage at the far end of the warehouse. Use physically believable moving-head stage lights, restrained laser beams, and localized red, blue, and violet illumination.

Bright light sources create realistic contrast against the dark environment. Lighting beams are visible through thin, uneven atmospheric haze, without excessive fog or artificial glowing effects.

CROWD REALISM

Preserve believable audience density on the ground floor and spectators along both upper balcony levels.

People have varied postures, clothing, hairstyles, and natural body proportions. Most distant faces remain indistinct because of darkness, distance, and atmospheric conditions.

Avoid repeated poses, perfectly spaced audience formations, synchronized gestures, and unnaturally crisp individual figures.

CAMERA AND PHOTOGRAPHIC AUTHENTICITY

The image must resemble a genuine photograph captured by an experienced nightlife photographer using a professional full-frame camera during an actual live performance.

Use realistic low-light exposure, deep natural shadows, subtle high-ISO sensor grain, organic shadow noise, restrained highlight bloom, natural color variation, and realistic atmospheric depth.

Allow distant details to become indistinct. Preserve convincing physical materials, imperfect concrete, weathered industrial steel, and natural light absorption.

Avoid the appearance of CGI, architectural visualization, 3D rendering, synthetic concert promotional artwork, excessive HDR, artificial skin smoothing, and uniformly sharp details.

FINAL VISUAL GOAL

A believable underground techno event photographed inside a massive three-level industrial warehouse. The atmosphere is dark, immersive, imperfect, and authentic, with the stage and selected architectural elements emerging dramatically from deep shadow.

The image should feel like a real moment captured during an actual rave, not a digitally constructed visualization.

使用提供的仓库参考图，创作一张地下工业科技锐舞派对的纪实风格真实照片，捕捉现场 DJ 表演的瞬间。

建筑与构图

保留仓库原有的三层建筑结构、承重立柱、钢结构夹层、栏杆、中央中庭、舞台位置以及俯视的机位视角。保持原建筑可辨识的几何形态。

灯光与黑暗

将场地转变为真正幽暗的地下夜店。天花板与上部屋顶结构几乎完全隐没于深黑阴影之中。玻璃屋顶面板和窗户不得有明显照明。只有在偶发反射光触及之处，才显现出混凝土梁与结构构件的模糊、不规则轮廓。

沿结构立柱保留克制的紫色与靛蓝色建筑泛光照明，光线衰减真实，灯具之间保留大片黑暗。

中央舞池的观众随着远离直接光源而逐渐变暗。大多数人呈现为交叠的剪影，偶尔以轮廓光勾勒出头部、肩膀、头发与举起的手臂。避免将观众背面均匀照亮。

左侧和右侧底层边缘的人群在局部顶光下仍部分可见，曝光带有自然变化。夹层观众接受间歇性反射的舞台光，许多面部与身体处于部分遮蔽状态。

舞台与演出

保持 DJ  booth 与表演舞台位于仓库远端。使用物理上可信的摇头舞台灯、克制的激光束，以及局部的红、蓝、紫色照明。

明亮光源在黑暗环境中形成真实对比。灯光束在稀薄、不均匀的大气雾霭中可见，但不过量烟雾，也无人工发光特效。

人群真实感

保留底层可信的观众密度，以及上下两层夹层的观众。

人们姿态、服装、发型与身体比例各异。多数远处面孔因黑暗、距离和大气条件而模糊不清。

避免重复姿势、间距过于规整的人群阵列、同步动作，以及异常清晰的个体人物。

相机与摄影真实性

画面须 resembling 一位有经验的夜生活摄影师使用专业全画幅相机、在真实现场演出中拍摄的真实照片。

使用真实的低光曝光、深沉自然的阴影、细微的高 ISO 传感器颗粒、有机的暗部噪点、克制的高光泛光、自然的色彩变化，以及真实的大气景深。

允许远处细节变得模糊不清。保留令人信服的物理材质、不完美的混凝土、风化的工业钢材，以及自然的光吸收特性。

避免出现 CGI、建筑可视化、3D 渲染、合成演出宣传图、过度 HDR、人工磨皮，以及整体过于锐利的细节。

最终视觉目标

一场可信的地下科技演出，拍摄于一座巨大的三层工业仓库内部。氛围幽暗、沉浸、不完美且真实，舞台与精选的建筑元素从深重阴影中戏剧性地浮现。

画面应像是在真实锐舞派对中捕捉到的真实瞬间，而非数字构建的可视化效果。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action cinematic fantasy action, 15 seconds, 16:9. The first frame fully preserves <Picture 1>: the same adult lightning goddess, black-and-gold battle suit, golden cape, curly hair, storm battlefield, broken stone ground, sparks, thunderclouds, blue-white lightning, and the four visible robots in their original positions. The whole sequence remains inside the same encirclement. A stays at the center and moves only one to two steps; B remains front-left, C front-right, D rear-left, and E rear-right. All destroyed states persist: broken knees, severed arms, opened chest armor, shattered necks, exploded capacitors, fallen fragments, smoke, and molten edges never restore.

[Shot 1] A moves on frame one. In a ground-hugging low-angle push-in, her boot slams into broken stone, blasting gravel, rain-mud dust, and sparks outward. A zenith lightning bolt strikes into her raised right hand and compresses instantly into a giant blue-white thunder blade longer than her arm. Her pupils lock on B before the head turns; brow tightens slightly, lips pull into a cold line. She bursts half a step toward front-left and spins into a brutal horizontal slash. The thunder blade skims the ground in a semicircular arc, slicing B’s knee joints, then reverses upward into B’s chest core. B’s knees explode apart, the body collapses into a ruined kneel, and the chest bursts outward. Metal fragments spray in a fan; black smoke tears upward. As A rises and stops hard, armor, torso, cape, and curly hair all show one brief real inertia response. B remains kneeling, chest blown open.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, a whip-pan flash-shake snaps the view toward frame-right. C swings a heavy fist. The camera side-tracks as A rotates her hips and slips past the punch wind. Her eyes flash dangerous contempt and one mouth corner compresses into a short cold smirk. The thunder blade softens into a giant lightning whip, sliding along the cape’s metal edge, then lashing out from her waist side. It wraps around C’s mechanical arm and shoulder joint. A yanks with both hands; the whip tightens, tearing the arm away. The severed arm flies off with a blue-white electric tail, hits the ground, and bounces once. The same current drills into C’s chest cavity and crushes the core inward. C falls with a severed arm and collapsed chest, locked in that state.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, a rapid push-pull impact shot rushes into A’s palm and snaps back to a half-body frame. The lightning whip recoils into a violent electric core, then straightens into a thunder spear. A never poses; feet keep adjusting, shoulders drop, breath shortens, and chest armor shows a brief breath-and-braking response. Her gaze cuts from C’s wreckage toward D, pupils moving first; jaw tightens and the expression cools into precise targeting.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.000, FPV high-speed traversal begins from A’s palm along the thunder spear. The camera rides the spear through smoke, sparks, airborne fragments, and rain mist toward D’s head-neck joint. The spear is a high-speed plasma lance, not a beam. On impact, the white core flashes; D’s neck, shoulder armor, and sensors burst together. D sinks into a half-kneel, black smoke coughing from the rear. As the spear grazes fragments, secondary branching arcs leap through them, reinforcing the conductive path. D remains half-kneeling, neck shattered and disabled.

[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, the camera rises from a low angle into a brief overhead cut. A grabs the returning spear with both hands; it folds into a giant thunder hammer. The low angle sees her short-jump inside the same encirclement, never leaving center. Knees rise, core tightens, shoulders and back load the strike, and the golden cape explodes backward in heavy folds. She hammers downward. The camera follows the hammer into a short overhead cut as it smashes E’s back capacitor and spine armor. A ground-hugging shockwave erupts, dust expands in a circular ring, stones rise then fall, and E’s back armor detonates segment by segment. The body arches backward and breaks apart with black smoke columns and orange-gold sparks. A lands; the impact and breath create another brief armor-supported body response while hair and cape settle late.

[Shot 6] At 00:10.600, rebound variable-speed camera movement snaps from E’s blast point back to A at center, slowing briefly, then accelerating again. A lands and immediately spins once. From her palm, four extremely thin high-brightness arcs shoot into the damaged cores of B, C, D, and E like simultaneous execution lines. B’s chest core dies, C’s collapsed chest flashes blue once, D’s broken neck sparks briefly, and E’s back capacitor burns fully black. A’s eyes scan the wreckage with one instant of controlled satisfaction, then the look is suppressed back into alertness.

[Shot 7] At 00:12.200, the camera pulls back fast, rises slightly into a shallow overhead angle, and makes a small arc around the same encirclement. All four ruined robots are clearly visible in their locked positions: B kneeling with chest blown open, C fallen with severed arm and crushed chest, D half-kneeling with broken head-neck assembly, E smoking with exploded back armor. A stands in the center. She closes her right hand, forcibly drawing the four residual arcs back into her palm like weapons returning to a sheath. Her cape slowly falls; curly hair remains faintly lifted by the residual electric field. Her gaze moves across all four wrecks, then passes beyond the frame toward a distant unseen threat. Brow presses down again; expression shifts from post-kill sharpness into deeper vigilance. Hold the medium-wide battlefield aftertone: distant thunder, cooling metal crackle, rolling black smoke, falling sparks, blue-white rim light on armor, and warm fire reflection on the golden cape. No blackout and no fade.

Lighting and color remain consistent: storm-cold base with deep blue-grey and teal shadows, high-bright blue-white lightning, orange-gold sparks, white-hot molten metal edges, and natural warm-brown skin that never turns dead grey. Black-and-gold armor receives sharp blue-white rim light; the golden cape catches warm fire reflection. Grade: high-contrast teal-gold storm action with shadow cyan-blue #0B1A24, electric blue-white #DFF7FF, cold steel grey #59646B, spark orange-gold #FF8A2A, dark cape gold #B88A38. Highlights roll off softly, blacks stay deep but readable, and smoke, rain mist, sparks, and dust catch lightning edge light.

VFX rules: lightning always behaves like a giant weapon with a white core, plasma shell, branching fine arcs, motion trails, and air-ionization mist. Every attack has source, path, impact point, and result: zenith lightning enters A’s palm, clings to bracers, chest armor, cape metal edges, waistline, and boot soles, then reshapes into thunder blade, whip, spear, and hammer. Current never jumps randomly; it returns through metal fragments, robot armor seams, ground cracks, and capacitor structures. Explosions contain white-hot cores, blue electric fire, orange-gold sparks, black smoke columns, dust shockwaves, falling stones, and molten edges.

overall_soundscape: Continuous storm battlefield ambience with thundercloud rumble, rain mist, gravel impacts, heavy boot strikes, armor movement, cape snaps, and cooling wreckage crackle. Each lightning weapon has a distinct sound: thunder blade shears with a sharp plasma roar, thunder whip snaps and tightens with electrical cable strain, thunder spear screams through smoke at high speed, and thunder hammer lands with a heavy sub-bass impact, stone burst, metal rupture, black smoke, and orange spark scatter. Robot destruction stays physical and weighted: knee joints bursting, chest cores exploding, a severed arm hitting the ground, neck armor shattering, capacitors detonating, debris falling, and residual arcs being forcibly pulled back into A’s palm.

non_diegetic_music: Fast storm-action percussion with low taiko-like impacts, distorted metal hits, and pulsing sub-bass locked to each weapon transformation. A sharp high-string tremolo and electric drones rise during the FPV spear strike, then reduce into low sustained brass and distant percussion under the final battlefield hold.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 真人实拍电影级奇幻动作，15 秒，16:9。第一帧完整保留 <Picture 1>：同一位成年雷电女神、黑金战甲、金色披风、卷发、风暴战场、破碎石地、火花、雷云、蓝白色闪电，以及位于原始位置的四个可见机器人。整个段落始终处于同一包围圈之内。A 始终位于中心，只移动一到两步；B 保持在左前方，C 在右前方，D 在左后方，E 在右后方。所有损毁状态持续存在：断裂的膝关节、断臂、敞开的胸甲、粉碎的颈部、爆炸的电容、坠落的碎片、烟雾与熔融边缘绝不恢复。

[Shot 1] A 在第一帧就动了起来。在贴地的低角度推镜头中，她的靴子砸进破碎的石头，碎石、雨水泥浆尘土和火花向外爆开。一道天顶闪电击入她抬起的右手，瞬间压缩成一把比她手臂还长的巨型蓝白色雷霆刃。她的瞳孔在头部转动之前就锁定 B；眉头微微收紧，嘴唇拉成一条冷冽的线。她朝左前方爆发半步，旋身斩出一道凶猛的水平横斩。雷霆刃以半圆弧线掠过地面，切开 B 的膝关节，随即反向向上切入 B 的胸部核心。B 的双膝爆开，躯体瘫成一具残破的跪姿，胸部向外炸裂。金属碎片呈扇形喷散；黑烟向上撕裂翻涌。当 A 起身并猛然停住时，甲衣、躯干、披风和卷风都短暂呈现出一次真实的惯性反应。B 保持跪姿，胸部被轰开。

[Shot 2] 在 00:03.000 处，一记甩镜加闪晃把视线甩向画面右侧。C 挥出沉重的一拳。摄影机侧向跟移，A 转动胯部，从拳风的边缘滑过。她的眼中闪过危险的轻蔑，嘴角一侧压出一个短促而冰冷的冷笑。雷霆刃软化成一条巨型闪电鞭，沿着披风的金属边缘滑行，随即从她腰侧甩出。它缠住 C 的机械臂与肩关节。A 双手用力回拽；鞭索收紧，把那条手臂扯断。断臂带着蓝白色的电弧尾迹飞出，砸在地上弹跳一次。同一股电流钻入 C 的胸腔，将核心向内压碎。C 倒下，断臂与胸口塌陷，锁定在该状态中。

[Shot 3] 在 00:05.000 处，一个快速推拉的冲击镜头猛冲进 A 的掌心，又弹回半身构图。闪电鞭回缩成一个暴烈的电流核心，随后挺直为雷霆矛。A 从不摆姿势；双脚不断微调，肩膀下沉，呼吸变短，胸甲出现短暂的呼吸与制动反应。她的视线从 C 的残骸切向 D，瞳孔先行移动；下颌收紧，表情冷却为精准锁定。

[Shot 4] 在 00:06.000 处，FPV 高速穿越从 A 的掌心沿雷霆矛开始。摄影机骑乘长矛穿过烟雾、火花、空中碎片与雨雾，冲向 D 的头颈关节。这柄矛是高速等离子枪矛，而非光束。命中时，白色核心闪亮；D 的颈部、肩甲与传感器同时爆裂。D 沉入半跪，后方咳出黑烟。当长矛擦过碎片时，次级分支电弧在其中跳跃，强化导电路径。D 保持半跪，颈部粉碎并失去行动能力。

[Shot 5] 在 00:08.000 处，摄影机从低角度升起，切入一个短暂俯拍。A 双手抓住飞回的矛；它折叠成一把巨型雷霆锤。低角度拍到她在同一包围圈内做短跳，始终没有离开中心。膝盖抬起，核心收紧，肩背蓄力蓄势，金色披风以厚重褶皱向后炸开。她向下砸锤。摄影机跟随锤子切入一个短暂俯拍，砸碎 E 的背部电容与脊甲。贴地冲击波爆发，尘埃以圆环状扩散，石块升起又落下，E 的背甲逐段引爆。躯体向后弓起并炸裂开来，带起黑烟柱与橙金色火花。A 落地；冲击与呼吸再次引发短暂的甲衣支撑躯体反应，头发与披风稍晚才落定。

[Shot 6] 在 00:10.600 处，弹跳式变速运镜从 E 的爆点甩回位于中心的 A，短暂减速，随后再次加速。A 落地并立即旋身一次。从她掌心，四道极细的高亮电弧射入 B、C、D、E 受损的核心，如同同时落下的处刑线。B 的胸部核心熄灭，C 塌陷的胸口闪了一次蓝光，D 粉碎的颈部短暂迸出火花，E 的背部电容彻底烧黑。A 的目光扫过残骸，带着一瞬间受控的满足，随后这神情又被压回警觉。

[Shot 7] 在 00:12.200 处，摄影机快速后拉，略微升起形成浅俯角，并绕同一包围圈做小幅弧线移动。四台残破机器人在各自锁定状态下清晰可见：B 跪着、胸部被轰开，C 倒地、断臂且胸口被压碎，D 半跪、头颈组件粉碎，E 冒烟、背甲炸裂。A 站在中央。她握紧右手，强行将四道残余电弧拉回掌心，如同武器归鞘。披风缓缓落下；卷发仍被残余电场微微托起。她的目光扫过四具残骸，随后越过画框，投向远处某个看不见的威胁。眉头再次压下；表情从杀戮后的锐利转入更深的戒备。保持中远景战场余韵：远方雷声、冷却金属的噼啪声、翻卷的黑烟、飘落的火花、甲衣上的蓝白色轮廓光，以及金色披风上的暖色火光反射。不 blackout，不 fade。

光照与色彩保持一致：风暴冷调基调，深蓝灰与青绿色阴影，高亮蓝白闪电，橙金色火花，白热熔融金属边缘，以及永不变成死灰色的自然暖棕色皮肤。黑金甲衣接收锐利的蓝白轮廓光；金色披风捕捉暖色火光反射。调色：高对比青金风暴动作风，暗部青蓝 #0B1A24，电光蓝白 #DFF7FF，冷钢灰 #59646B，火花橙金 #FF8A2A，暗披风金 #B88A38。高光柔和滚降，黑位深沉但仍可读，烟雾、雨雾、火花与尘埃捕捉闪电边缘光。

VFX 规则：闪电始终表现为巨型武器，具备白色核心、等离子外壳、分支细电弧、运动拖影与空气电离雾。每次攻击都有源头、路径、命中点与结果：天顶闪电进入 A 的掌心，附着于护臂、胸甲、披风金属边缘、腰线与靴底，然后变形成雷霆刃、雷霆鞭、雷霆矛与雷霆锤。电流绝不随机跳跃；它通过金属碎片、机器人甲缝、地面裂缝与电容结构回流。爆炸包含白热核心、蓝色电火、橙金色火花、黑烟柱、尘土冲击波、坠落石块与熔融边缘。

overall_soundscape: 持续的风暴战场环境音，包含雷云轰鸣、雨雾、碎石撞击、重靴踏击、甲衣移动、披风抽打与残骸冷却噼啪声。每种闪电武器都有独特音效：雷霆刃剪切时发出尖锐等离子轰鸣，雷霆鞭抽打收紧时带电缆般的电流张力，雷霆矛高速穿过烟雾时发出尖啸，雷霆锤落下时伴随沉重的次低频冲击、碎石爆裂、金属撕裂、黑烟与橙色火花四散。机器人毁灭始终具有物理质感与重量感：膝关节爆开、胸部核心爆炸、断臂落地、颈部甲片粉碎、电容引爆、碎片坠落，以及残余电弧被强行拉回 A 的掌心。

non_diegetic_music: 快速风暴动作打击乐，配有低沉的太鼓式冲击、扭曲金属敲击，以及与每次武器变形同步的脉动次低频。FPV 长矛突刺期间升起尖锐的高弦颤音与电子嗡鸣，随后在最后的战场定格中减弱为低沉的持续铜管与远方打击乐。
